name: Roo Code
summary: Open-source VS Code AI coding agent with Code, Architect, Ask and Debug modes; shut down in May and pointing to forks.
description: An open-source (Apache-2.0) VS Code extension that puts an LLM coding agent in the editor: generate code from natural-language specs, refactor and debug existing code, answer questions about a codebase and automate repetitive tasks. Work is organised into Modes (Code, Architect, Ask, Debug and custom modes) and it can call MCP servers. The extension was shut down on May 15 and the README now points to the community fork ZooCode and to Cline.
